1 People & Office Specialist Why This Role Matters
This isn't just a job; it's a chance to be part of something bigger.

You'll join a global team with a shared mission: to advance performance in healthcare.

Here's how your contributions will shape meaningful outcomes:

 * Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers regarding HR policies, processes, and routine queries.

 * Provide HR administration support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, records, and documentation.

 * Be responsible for local payroll and time & attendance administration, coordinating with Finance, the regional People team, and external payroll providers.

 * Support the consistent application of HR policies and employment legislation while handling confidential information appropriately.

 * Work closely with local and Global People teams to deliver HR processes and initiatives.

 * Coordinate office administration, including visitor management, travel arrangements, and office supplies.

 * Maintain local documentation, records, and organisational knowledge to support business continuity.

What You'll Get
Be part of a culture built on trust, care, and shared ownership.

Flexibility, wellbeing, and benefits that reflect our commitment to you.

 * Minimum salary according to the Collective Agreement for Employees in Trade, Crafts and Services, Employment Group IV. The actual salary will depend on qualifications and relevant professional experience.

 * Part-time: 20 hours per week

 * Fixed-term employment for 18 months

 * May be eligible for an annual bonus of up to 5%

 * Vacation entitlement according to Austrian law and the applicable collective agreement

 * Wellbeing initiatives

What You Bring
 * Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken

 * Relevant academic qualification or equivalent professional experience in HR or administration

 * Hands-on experience in HR administration and operations

 * Practical working knowledge of core HR processes, including:

 ** Contracts

 ** Personnel records

 ** Labour-law basics

 ** Payroll coordination

 ** Time-tracking administration

 * Proven ability to handle confidential employee and payroll data with discretion, integrity, and strong data protection awareness

 * Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage HR and office tasks independently

 * Ability to prioritise effectively and meet payroll and compliance deadlines

 * Clear communicator with strong interpersonal skills

Our Approach to Diversity & Inclusion
We're building a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and valued.

We believe that a diverse mix of people from different cultures, ages, geographies, and genders makes us stronger. It brings fresh perspectives, drives better decisions, and helps us deliver solutions that reflect the world we serve.

Inclusion isn't just a value; it's how we work, grow, and lead together.

About Mölnlycke
Mölnlycke is a world-leading medical products and solutions company that equips healthcare professionals to achieve the best patient, clinical, and economic outcomes.

Our business is organised into four business areas: Wound Care, Operating Room Solutions, Gloves, and Antiseptics. Customer centricity, sustainability, and digitalisation are at the heart of everything we do.

Mölnlycke employs around 8,700 people. The company headquarters are located in Gothenburg, Sweden, and we operate in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Mölnlycke is a founding partner of GoCo Health Innovation City, a world-class innovation cluster for health.

Since 2007, the company has been part of Investor AB, an engaged owner of high-quality, global companies that was founded by the Wallenberg family in 1916.

For more information, please visit:

The Operations Associate, Courier Community acts as the heartbeat of the courier partner support ecosystem. Serving as the first line of human support beyond frontline Customer Support, this role is the critical bridge between Wolt and its courier partners. 

In this role, you will balance deep empathy with efficient, high-volume problem-solving - handling complex escalations, localized communications, sensitive account situations, and workflow automations that keep courier partners informed, supported, and valued.

Key Responsibilities
Inbox Management & Advanced Support

 * Manage courier inbox channels to handle complex, partner-submitted requests.
 * Resolve escalated tickets transferred from Support that fall outside frontline scope, including complaints, bug reports, and sensitive account updates.
 * Maintain team SLAs by keeping inbox tasks within a target 72-hour reply rate and resolving open board tickets efficiently.

Content Ownership & Localization

 * Localize regional and global courier-facing communications for specific country languages and cultural contexts.
 * Maintain and continuously update localized courier platforms, including country FAQs, educational content, and operational resources.
 * Proactively maintain information accessibility so couriers can easily self-solve issues without contacting support.

Cross-Functional Communication & Enablement

 * Coordinate ad-hoc courier announcements (e.g., weather-related boosts) in alignment with Communications and Supply Activation teams.
 * Create macros, guidance documents, and tools for Customer Support to empower frontline agents to resolve cases independently.
 * Assist onboarding teams with document verification, profile activations, and country-specific onboarding tasks.

Community Engagement & Feedback Loops

 * Drive community engagement by supporting local feedback initiatives and courier events.
 * Capture operational insights from courier feedback and translate them into process, documentation, and tool improvements.

AI & Process Automation

 * Leverage AI tools day-to-day to generate clear, empathetic response templates and reduce manual workloads for routine inquiries.
 * Utilize AI and self-service tools to summarize ticket escalations, maintain up-to-date knowledge bases, and build smart routing workflows.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Impact

 * Courier Satisfaction: Measured through feedback scores, response quality, and communication empathy.
 * Time to Resolution (TTR): Fast, efficient, and accurate resolution for complex tickets passed from Support or directly from courier partners.
 * Inflow Reduction: Lower overall ticket volume achieved through scalable documentation, improved Support macros, and self-service automation.
 * Localization Quality: High accuracy and quick turnaround time for market-specific announcements and content updates.

Our humble expectations
 * Professional working experience in Customer Support, Operations or other similar roles.
 * Professional level in English and (Austrian) German.
 * Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.
 * Strong capability to diagnose operational issues, identify root causes, and determine when and how to escalate.
 * Clear, empathetic, and professional written communication skills.
 * Ownership & Accountability: Taking full responsibility for tasks until completion and communicating early when blocked.
 * Attention to Detail: Meticulous with workflows, deadlines, and sensitive partner details.
 * Multitasking & Adaptability: Thriving in a fast-paced environment where priorities dynamically adjust.

Pay Range : €2.109-€2.636 EUR

APPLY NOW!

jobs.description:
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014, we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 1000 cities in 30+ countries around the world.

We try to make every city we enter a better place - and by that we mean making our customers happy, supporting local businesses, and creating earning opportunities wherever we go. 3 Asc. Operations Manager, Supply Acquisition & Activation (m/w/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central's most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central's ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you'll be doing

 * Own Central's intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

 * Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

 * Own Central's courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

 * Own and report on Central's UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

 * Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

 * Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

 * Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central's supply health.

Our humble expectations

 * Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

 * Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

 * Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

 * Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

 * Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 * Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

 * Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing. 

The salary below is the gross monthly salary range for this position. 

€6.503-€8.129 EUR

What You Bring

 * Proficiency with MS Office suite and SAP is strongly preferred; experience with other IT tools for data analysis (e.g., Power BI) is a plus.
